lessons_used: Sign-In: Post-adoption placement, pet recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners won; reordering sign-in elsewhere hurt or had no clear effect, while sync safety notices showed no clear effect.

Choose Path: Clarity and value headlines, visual stage redesigns, spotlight layouts, and outcome clarity tips won; checklist layouts, scroll redesigns, and reassurance notes hurt, while simplified copy had no clear effect.

Home: Interactive waiting rooms, readiness status checks, and desktop spawn hints won; progress trackers, sound alerts, completion timers, readiness redesigns, and compatibility checks had no clear effect.

Adoption: Photo quality guide previews and split preview layouts won; compact grids, guideline banners, mascot stamps, fallback flows, spotlight views, and multi-step inspection flows hurt; pre-adoption reviews and incentives showed no clear effect.

Finish: Interactive spawn placement flows, placement verification screens, and tray location tips won; direct control guides, guided spawn stages, and first-interaction tips hurt; welcome stage redesigns showed no clear effect.

Predictions: Underpredicted gains on added flow steps (like placement verification screens and spawn flows), while overpredicting performance on severe flow disruptions (like mascot stamps, direct control guides, and guided spawn stages).

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Tray Control Hint Badge
candidates.change: Adds a clear tray control guidance badge to the final welcome screen explaining how to minimize, reveal, and access controls from the system tray.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails reported confusion about how to control, hide, or retrieve the pet after onboarding.

home_intro.hint: Check your desktop system tray icon to hide, show, or customize your companion anytime.

guard.reason: Adds desktop tray control guidance to home_intro within allowed onboarding customization.

candidates.score_note: Tray location tips and finish hints historically win (+3.6% avg), directly addressing support confusion.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Lighting Preview Flow
candidates.change: Replaces the photo upload screen component with a carousel guide showing optimal lighting and photo angles before uploading.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (68.9%) and support received multiple complaints about custom pet generation failing or rendering poorly.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Photos of Your Companion

photo_upload.text: Use bright lighting and clear front angles for best 3D pet generation results.

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.replace.photo_upload[0]': a tip_carousel cannot do the photo_upload job (use ['button', 'checklist', 'image', 'photo_picker', 'text'])

candidates.title: Story Stage Card Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the story intro screen into a visual stage layout featuring interactive companion story elements.
candidates.why: Mean time spent on choose_path is high (514s); previous story visual redesigns and spotlight layouts significantly improved user progression.

story.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
story.body: Choose how you want to bring your digital companion to life on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: replacement for 'story.intro_story' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'video'] with an asset:story/ asset

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Sync Warning Banner
candidates.change: Adds an account restoration notification banner on the sign-in screen informing returning users how to sync existing pets.
candidates.why: The top support theme with 8 emails involved users losing or resetting pets after signing in with a different account method.

sign_in.hint: Log in with your existing account to restore all previously saved pets and progress.

guard.reason: Adds an account restoration info badge to the sign-in screen without modifying outer flows or pricing.

candidates.score_note: Addresses top support complaint (8 emails), but sign-in drop-off is already low (4.8%) and sync banners had mixed history.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Activity Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the waiting screen into an animated activity stage showing desktop preparation progress.
candidates.why: The waiting stage takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s; interactive waiting room designs previously won and reduced drop-off.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Space
waiting.body: Your companion is getting ready to spawn on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: replacement for 'waiting.wait_status' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['preview', 'progress', 'timer']

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Naming Preview Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated pet naming screen right before generating the official adoption certificate.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops sharply to 68.9%; breaking adoption into distinct interactive steps reduces drop-off.

new_naming_preview.headline: Name Your Desktop Companion
new_naming_preview.body: Give your new pet a name that will appear on its official adoption certificate.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.hint: Your companion is officially ready to move onto your desktop.

guard.reason: Inserts a new pet naming screen into onboarding while preserving all required onboarding steps and jobs.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off (31.1%), but adding extra flow steps/screens to adoption consistently hurts conversion (-6.5% avg).

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Status Tip Banner
candidates.change: Adds a visibility tip banner on the home intro screen reassuring users if the pet spawns behind active windows.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets where users reported the pet not showing up on desktop or being unable to open it.

home_intro.body: Your companion is now active! If you do not see it immediately, check your system tray or minimize active windows.

components.text: Right-click the tray icon if your pet is hidden behind active application windows.

guard.reason: Adds visibility tips on home_intro without violating onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Supported by email feedback about hidden pets; wait_info changes average +1.6% relative lift.

candidates.title: Choose Path Outcome Comparison Layout
candidates.change: Changes the choose path layout to a two-column layout comparing pre-made vs custom pet choices.
candidates.why: Mean time spent choosing a path is 514s; side-by-side outcome clarity helps users make decisions faster.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Pet Experience
choose_path.body: Pick a ready-to-adopt companion or upload photos to create a completely custom pet.
choose_path.hint: Pre-made pets launch faster, while custom pets take a few moments to generate.

guard.reason: Updates choose_path layout while continuing to offer both adoption and custom pet paths.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long duration on choose_path (514s mean); outcome clarity visual redesigns won in past tests.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Selection Carousel Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a horizontal carousel showcasing interactive pet preview cards.
candidates.why: Adoption drops down to 68.9%; enhancing visual feedback during companion pick boosts adoption completion.

pick_friend.headline: Browse Companion Pets
pick_friend.body: Explore different pet personalities and choose your ideal companion.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Sign-In Account Loss Prevention Headline
candidates.change: Updates the sign-in headline and call to action to explicitly state that signing in saves and syncs existing pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save & Restore Your Pets
sign_in.body: Signing in ensures your pet data, customization, and progress remain safe across devices.

guard.reason: Updates sign-in copy to emphasize pet sync without introducing dark patterns or pricing text.

candidates.score_note: Pet recovery copy won previously and sign_in copy changes average +1.9%; quick copy-only fix.

lessons_next: Sign-In: Post-adoption placement, recovery/loss-prevention copy, and multi-device sync banners won; reordering sign-in elsewhere hurt or had no clear effect, while sync safety notices showed no clear effect.

Choose Path: Headline clarity updates, visual stage redesigns, spotlight layouts, and outcome clarity tips won; checklist layouts, scroll redesigns, reassurance notes, and comparison layouts hurt, while simplified copy had no clear effect.
Home: Interactive waiting rooms, status checks, and spawn location hints won; completion timers, readiness redesigns, sound alerts, progress trackers, and compatibility checks showed no clear effect.

Adoption: Photo quality preview guides, split preview layouts, and naming preview screens won; mascot stamps, fallback flows, spotlight views, compact grids, guideline banners, and multi-step inspection flows hurt.

Finish: Interactive spawn placement flows, tray placement verification screens, and system tray hints/tips won; direct control guides, guided spawn stages, and first-interaction tips hurt, while welcome redesigns showed no clear effect.

Predictions: Predictions were systematically too low on beneficial new screens and verification steps (e.g., placement verification and naming preview screens), while overpredicting performance on disruptive flow overhauls and complex extra steps.
